laboratory_anchors: Seer, Inc. / Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center

ledger.coordinate_definition: Each record retains the original source asset, worksheet, row and measurement-specific cell coordinate.
ledger.transformation: Strictly positive finite author values are converted to descending midrank percentiles within their source-defined measurement batch; zero, blank and NA values remain non-rank-eligible source states.

prohibited_interpretations: The rank percentile is not a cross-study concentration, an absolute protein abundance, or a clinical biomarker value.
An omitted source record, a source blank, a source NA or a source-reported zero is not a negative protein-detection label.
Laboratory anchor, study identity, facility code, worksheet and source-coordinate fields are provenance/splitting variables and are prohibited predictive features.
target_definition.target_description: For a uniquely mapped human protein record, rank a strictly positive finite author-reported quantity against all strictly positive author-reported protein quantities in the same source-defined measurement batch; use descending midrank percentile on [0,1].
